Curating playlists according to the diverse tastes of people, he includes tracks from various genres of music. From energetic to slower tracks, he has everything. Commercial

Working Style Of D.J Deepak

With his wealth of experience, he has mastered the skill of sensing the mood of the crowd. From hype to romantic, he plays tunes that go with the moment. Be it your bridal entry or a couple’s dance, he knows how to create the perfect moment. With a diverse collection of songs, he makes sure that everyone has fun on the dance floor. description: Picture Mantra is a photography company based in Delhi NCR. They believe, ‘We don’t just click photos; we paint memories, memories which you can cherish for a long time, memories to bring a smile whenever you are in need of it.’ They understand that the images they create put impact directly or indirectly on the way their clients and their brand are perceived. As a result, they have an unrelenting commitment to excellence when working on projects; employing careful planning, up-to-date technology, and their best skills all the time. To achieve this, they ensure that their creative staff is constantly abreast with the latest thinking and technology in their field. Being the firm believer of the fact that ‘Photography is not a profession, it’s a passion’ they click every single moment of your fairytale wedding in most striking and stylish fashion. And when one is driven insanely by passion of capturing emotions, moods and moments with the click of camera, the outcome is indeed a memory for life. They have an eye for detail and their USP lies in adding creativity and spontaneity to your momentous occasion by using sophisticated and latest technology while capturing moments. Every picture has a story behind it and they try and bring out the essence of that story to the surface with their photography skills. They have been with WedMeGood since 2 years and 8 months.

description: The Delhi based Khushi Film Art has been in the wedding photography industry for the long run now. Sukhbir Singh Aka “Sukhi” is a well-known name in cinematic wedding films and candid photography across India and he is the man behind this venture. He has a decent experience in the field of photography. He has the eye to watch beauty through his lens and is extremely talented in capturing the beauty in its natural light. Sukhbir Singh is passionate about what he is doing. He and his team is a well-known name in this arena even now the world knows them. This team ensures to capture raw and genuine moments of love in your wedding day without you even noticing their presence. They aim to capture fleeting moments of your wedding day that unfold as the day goes on for you to relive forever. This team specializes in candid photography and is always on the lookout for beautiful and joyous moments to capture and show them in their natural light. Their actual strength lies in creating artistic, expressive and whimsical images which makes their style unique. They provide around 300-500 processed pictures to cherish for a lifetime.

With state-of-the-art equipment such as Canon Mark III 6D, Canon Mark III 5D, Canon C300 and drones, sliders, and jibs, the team captures all the special moments of your wedding in high-definition videos and photos. Mountain Roots Production's wedding package includes a wide range of customised solutions regarding all your videography and photography needs. From engagement shoot to providing a slideshow on your reception, all your events will be ideally covered and the outcome will be presented in a well-edited, customised digital album. Since their inception in 2013, they aim to create audio-visual concepts for wedding. They pledge to comprehensively research our Clients goals, ethics and history to produce diverse story lines and concepts best suited to Client’s vision.

description: Cinewire are wedding photographers based in Delhi. Putting the best moments from your wedding in a frame in the most beautiful way is what Cinewire does. They put all those special moments untouched and beautiful just the way they happened. Capturing candid smiles is what they are best at. Instead of just clicking pictures, they capture all the laughter, the jokes, the teasing, the silent tears, the fleeting glances and the subdued smiles. Having an experience of many years in the industry, Cinewire has a team of professionals that understand the emotions of the bride and groom and make sure that they feel comfortable. Be it your engagement or your wedding, they will dig deeper into your story and shoot all the special moments, As they rightly say “We Capture You”.

description: The Wow Weddings, based out of Delhi NCR, specializes in freezing the best moments of your best day, allowing you to cherish these precious memories for a lifetime to come. What guides their work is the philosophy that photography is about people being real, and the process of capturing this very ‘realness’ and painting a picture with a camera such that it is remembered for a long, long time. The story that matters most is that of real people, who together form real stories comprising of real moments.

The brand prides itself on the unique and creative approaches they bring to every wedding photoshoot and film. Be it a traditional Indian wedding, an outdoor occasion or an intimate private affair, their team takes great pleasure in capturing every precious detail like a work of art. Their wedding albums reflect the distinct nature of each wedding while conveying the unique and beautiful stories of every couple. Each wedding covers all aspects of the journey from preparations to the irreplaceable moments between the bride and groom and the many beautiful candid shots of the close family and friends.

description: Snap Catchers is a wedding photography company based in Delhi, India. The company was founded by Tajinder Singh who has deep interest in capturing the timeless moments between couples on their wedding day. Their style has been described as modern yet romantic, using cinematic techniques to encapsulate the most natural and authentic moments in the couple’s special day. Snap Catchers is committed to creating beautiful photographs which are a combination of documentary and traditional storytelling. They take great pride in incorporating all of the details that make the day unique, from the architecture of the venue, to the intricate traditional clothing, and even the small gestures the couple makes throughout the day. They strive to create elegance and express emotions through their photography. Snap Catchers’ photography packages are tailored to each individual couple and can include a range of services such as pre and post wedding photography, traditional portraiture, elopement packages, and more. For years, Snap Catchers has been providing couples with beautiful photos that will remind them of the timeless moments that make up their special day.
